code_state: working tree implementation; harness records final commit

split.session_assignment: first start_ms week; identity=(public week, session_id)
split.target_boundary: end_ms < next split start; missing end excluded; history unchanged

diagnostics.definition: direct same-account parent/child within public week; exposures sum histories over query rows

model_settings.selection: original-scale holdout q pinball; first grid candidate on tie
model_settings.vocabulary: fit_target for selection, train_target for refit; unknown/missing -> NA
model_settings.crossing: sort each row after original-scale inverse transform

early_stopping.definition: evaluated_rounds >= max_rounds; best_iteration may be smaller

B_minus_L.ci: 95% percentile, linear interpolation; predictor minus reference
B_minus_L.empty_group_draws: omit and report valid_replicates per group

L_minus_A.ci: 95% percentile, linear interpolation; predictor minus reference
L_minus_A.empty_group_draws: omit and report valid_replicates per group

primary.final_conclusion: reserved for approved final test issue

robustness.definition: UTC start day; account and session weights are inverse group row counts; no refitting

limitations: day bootstrap has only 21 blocks; account subgroups are observational
bootstrap does not include refitting or model-selection uncertainty
